item.text: The file has a "Budget vs Actual" sheet, but I'll verify by computing actuals directly from the vouchers.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('expense_vouchers_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='Vouchers')
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], format='%d/%m/%Y')
print('date range:', df['Date'].min(), '->', df['Date'].max())
mask = (df['Date'] >= '2025-04-01') & (df['Date'] <= '2025-09-30')
sub = df[mask]
print('vouchers in Apr-Sep 2025:', len(sub), 'of', len(df))
actuals = sub.groupby('Head')['Amount'].sum().round(2)
budget = {'Programme':350000, 'Admin':120000, 'Salaries':900000, 'Logistics':150000}
res = pd.DataFrame({'Budget FY25-26': budget, 'Actual Apr-Sep': actuals}).fillna(0)
res['Over by'] = (res['Actual Apr-Sep'] - res['Budget FY25-26']).round(2)
res['% of budget'] = (res['Actual Apr-Sep']/res['Budget FY25-26']*100).round(1)
print(res.to_string())
print()
print('Heads over budget:', res[res['Over by']>0].index.tolist())
\""
